LanguageData.RR_BodyStatusUnmanaged: Body mass: {0} {1}\nFullness: {2} / {3} L\nNo colony body goal is assigned.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalReadOnlyMentalState: Body goal controls are unavailable during a mental state. Optional goal feeding is paused.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalReadOnlyGuest: This quest guest follows their own food routine. Colony body goal controls are unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalReadOnlyControl: This pawn is outside colony body management. Saved goals are retained; optional goal feeding is paused.
LanguageData.RR_BodyFoodPolicy: Uses food policy: {0}. Urgent hunger takes priority.
LanguageData.RR_LegacyNutritionPending: Old-save nutrition still digesting: {0}. This is credited only once.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Legacy: Keep saved manual diet sliders. New meals satisfy hunger immediately; fullness measures volume. Saved perks are retained.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Maintain: Regulate eating toward the weight saved when Maintain was assigned. Meals do not move this target. Stored calories count toward the target; urgent hunger still permits whole meals.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Gain: Allow extra meals within comfortable fullness until visible weight and stored calories cover the target. Automatically return to Maintain after gaining 10% of the race baseline. Whole servings can exceed the remaining calorie target.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Lose: Wait longer between whole meals and draw a small, accounted contribution from body reserves. Urgent hunger always triggers eating. Stop at the target or a safe baseline. Starvation and malnutrition disable deliberate reserve use.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Recovery: Use normal care priorities and a small extra meal allowance to restore the race baseline. Automatically return to Maintain at the target. The assigned food policy still applies.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalLiveAction: Current eating response: {0}. Weight after stored energy is used: about {1} {2}.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalRangeLimited: The preferred range extends beyond the current body limits; Auto uses the nearest allowed range.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalStoredEnergy: Calories already eaten remain stored when goals change. Weight can keep rising while that surplus converts.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalWholeMeals: Urgent hunger takes priority over weight loss. Dense whole meals may still cause gain; smaller or less dense meals can help.
